full_judgment: 15. It is seen that the kabala dated 11.04.1960 is very old instrument and the age of which is about 60 years. Thus, it stands that the kabala dated 11.04.1960 is more than 30 years of age which has been filed from the proper custody. Hence, we are inclined to hold that it certainly carried a legal presumption of due execution and correctness under section 90 of the Evidence Act.
